g.text: Two entry points, one pipeline — and what it downloads lands back where it started.
Stars an artist, or presses one cover
Greys out missing albums in the grid
imports into Navidrome's own music folder → reindexed in ~10s
• Two entry points, one pipeline: ⭐ is automatic and covers a whole discography; Request is manual and surgical.
• ImportListSync carries definitionId — that is what bypasses CustomImport's 6-hour MinRefreshInterval.
• Lidarr's own 'missing' count is useless here: it only sees its own root folder, so an 11-album FLAC collection stored elsewhere reads as entirely absent.
• The loop closes with no human in it. Nothing needs to be moved, renamed or rescanned.
